title: Ontology-Grounded, Reasoner-Verified Benchmarks for Evaluating LLM Reasoning in Scientific AI
abstract: arXiv:2610.00682v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly underpin scientific AI applications that reason over structured knowledge, from biomedical question answering to materials informatics. However, their logical reasoning often falls short, producing factual inaccuracies unacceptable in these settings. Reliable evaluation remains challenging: manual dataset construction scales poorly, and LLM-based generation risks embedding the very flaws it aims to measure. High-quality benchmarks must ground both correct and incorrect labelled examples in explicit background knowledge, formally verifiable by a standard reasoner. We propose a pipeline that automatically generates ontology-grounded multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmarks from any sufficiently axiomatised OWL 2 ontology, with correct answers grounded in the ontology by design. translated_title: 基于本体、由推理器验证的基准：用于评估科学人工智能中大语言模型推理能力
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）日益成为基于结构化知识进行推理的科学人工智能应用的基础，涵盖从生物医学问答到材料信息学等领域。然而，它们的逻辑推理能力往往不足，会产生在这些应用场景中不可接受的事实性错误。可靠的评估仍然充满挑战：手动构建数据集难以规模化，而基于LLM的自动生成则可能嵌入其本想衡量的那些缺陷。高质量的基准测试必须将正确和错误的标注示例都建立在明确的背景知识之上，并能够由标准推理器进行形式化验证。我们提出了一个自动化流水线，可从任何具有充分公理化的OWL 2本体自动生成基于本体的多选题（MCQ）基准，其中正确答案在设计上就根植于本体之中。干扰项通过扰动类定义公理右侧的类表达式来生成，其错误性由推理器进行形式化验证，从而确保基准的正确性标注可靠且可扩展。
tldr: 该论文提出一个自动化流水线，可从充分公理化的OWL 2本体自动生成以本体为基础、正确答案与干扰项均由标准推理器形式化验证的多选题基准，从而实现对大语言模型在科学AI场景中逻辑推理能力的可靠、可扩展评估。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an automated pipeline that generates ontology-grounded multiple-choice benchmarks from any sufficiently axiomatised OWL 2 ontology, with both correct answers and reasoner-verified distractors, enabling reliable and scalable evaluation of LLM logical reasoning in scientific AI applications.
